title: アオハル杯5戦目にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon and her team come together to overcome the target times Ms. Kashimoto set for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And from what I can see, they've come a long way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, it's time for round five of the Unity Cup! The day of the final showdown against Team Zenith has come at long last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite Team Zenith's overwhelming presence, Taiki Shuttle and the others are undaunted and determined to win. The races are about to begin…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The team pumps itself up with a rowdy cheer. Happy Hoppers, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The team pumps itself up with a rowdy cheer. Sunny Runners, let's go!
